label: There exists a graph-relative source s, every source equals s, and…, from confluence and source
meaning: Mathlib equivalence_join on reversed finite closure plus EqvGen.eqvGen_le joins every node x to any source s. The source has no upstream step, so its finite reflexive-transitive extension must be s; the other extension is converted by head induction to the existing FiniteCausalPath edge x s. Import SourceForest.atMostOne_of_confluent for source equality and package the exact existing RootedAtUniqueSource conclusion. No WF or population hypothesis is used: the source witness already supplies population. Source existence is assumed separately, not established by this derivation. This changes the earlier sufficient inputs connectivity+confluence+WF+population to connectivity+confluence+HasSource for the same conclusion; it neither proves the latter source premise nor removes any root obligation.
